rubric.point: Listing prime numbers on a die (2, 3, 5) and identifying favorable outcomes as 3
Calculating probability of getting a prime number: P(prime) = 3/6 = 1/2
Finding the probability of getting a number greater than 6: P(number > 6) = 0/6 = 0
